rule: For each tensor and scalar, the suite threshold is twice the largest deviation in the fixed reference-only family. Per-length thresholds use the same rule inside one length and are recorded beside the suite value. The stable margin is the minimum of twice the largest reference winner-change margin, including reference-only free-run first divergences, and twice the largest reference top-two gap error. Native measurements are not an input.
